privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Privacy policy of Ayiti Dijital. No cookies, no tracking, no data collection.
privacy.lead: This site sets no cookies, runs no analytics and collects no personal data. This page describes the little that happens anyway, and the rights you have.

items.title: We don't track you.
items.body: No cookies, no third-party pixels, no fingerprinting, no analytics.

items.title: No third-party content.
items.body: Images and fonts are served from our own domain. Browsing this site, your browser contacts no other server.

items.title: No collection.
items.body: No form on this site transmits or stores any data at present.

rows.label: Controller
rows.value: Ayiti Dijital (Verein in Gründung), Ursberger Str. 15, 81673 München, Deutschland

blocks.body: We are not required to appoint a data protection officer. For any question about your data, write to the address above.

This site is hosted by Vercel Inc. (United States). To deliver a page, your browser necessarily transmits technical data to the host: your IP address, the date and time of the request, the address requested, the referring site and your browser type. This processing is essential to making the site available and rests on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). As Vercel is a US company, a transfer of this technical data to the United States cannot be excluded.
This site sets no cookies and writes nothing to your browser's local storage. That is why you will not see a consent banner: there is nothing to accept or decline.
None. We use neither Google Analytics, nor Plausible, nor any other analytics, tracking or advertising tool. We do not know how many people visit this site.
Fonts are installed on and loaded from our own domain: your browser contacts no Google server. The site embeds no images, video, maps or widgets from any third-party service.

The newsletter forms on this site are not yet connected to a delivery service: anything entered is neither transmitted nor stored. Once those forms go live, this page will be updated before any data is collected.

items.title: Right of access
items.body: Obtain a copy of the data we hold about you.

items.title: Right to rectification
items.body: Correct any inaccurate or incomplete data.

items.title: Right to erasure
items.body: Request deletion of your data, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

items.title: Right to restriction
items.body: Restrict the processing of your data in certain cases.

items.title: Right to portability
items.body: Receive your data in a structured, reusable format.

items.title: Right to object
items.body: Object to the processing of your data at any time.

blocks.body: To exercise these rights, write to kontakt@ayitidijital.org; we respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the authority responsible for private bodies in Bavaria: the Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA), Ansbach — lda.bayern.de.
For any question about the protection of your data, exercising your rights, a complaint or a request, write to us directly.

consent.title: Audience measurement
consent.body: We'd like to measure this site's audience to understand what is useful to you. That measurement stores a cookie on your device and only starts if you agree. Declining changes nothing about your visit.
